# Lovable to Claude Code

> A step-by-step guide and automated migration script for taking a project built on Lovable, self-hosting it on Vercel for free, and continuing development in Claude Code instead of inside Lovable. Written for readers with no prior terminal experience. The README is the product; migrate.sh automates its steps. Authored by Nir Diamant. Licensed MIT.

## Core Documents

- [README](https://github.com/NirDiamant/lovable-to-claude-code/blob/main/README.md): The guide. Prerequisites and three steps, written for non-developers.
- [migrate.sh](https://github.com/NirDiamant/lovable-to-claude-code/blob/main/migrate.sh): The migration script the guide runs.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/NirDiamant/lovable-to-claude-code/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Instructions for Claude Code once the project has been migrated.
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/NirDiamant/lovable-to-claude-code/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository conventions for AI coding agents.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/NirDiamant/lovable-to-claude-code/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
